The tester dismissed only Google Drive from recent apps while the upload was in progress, waited, and reopened the app. The upload had already completed without a manual retry.

Environment: Samsung Galaxy S24 FE, Android 16, One UI 8.5, Google Drive 2.26.387.

title: Retry an interrupted upload without creating duplicate files
steps:
1. Open the local video. Record its file size and duration, and check playback at the beginning, middle, and end.
2. Open QA-Connectivity-Lab and start uploading TC15\_R01\_video.mp4 over Wi-Fi.
3. Disable Wi-Fi before the upload finishes. Keep mobile data disabled.
4. Observe for 30 seconds. Record the upload state, message, and whether an explicit retry action is available.
5. Restore Wi-Fi and confirm internet access. Check whether the interrupted upload still offers a retry action.
6. Capture evidence of the retry action, then select it once. Do not start a separate upload through the New or Upload menu.
7. Wait for completion and record the final status.
8. Refresh QA-Connectivity-Lab in the desktop browser. Inspect the folder for the original filename and any automatically renamed copies of the same video.
9. Download the uploaded video on the desktop. Compare its size and duration with the original, and check playback at the beginning, middle, and end.
10. Open the original video on the phone again.
steps_expected_result:
1. The video plays correctly. Reference details are recorded for comparison.
2. The upload is visibly in progress.
3. Connectivity is interrupted during the upload.
4. The upload is not falsely reported as completed. The availability or absence of a retry action is documented.
5. The retry action is available for the incomplete upload. If the app automatically recovers and no retry action is available, stop this case and record that the required condition was not reached.
6. The retry request is accepted and the interrupted upload restarts or resumes.
7. The upload completes with no pending upload or error indicator.
8. Exactly one resulting video file is present, named TC15\_R01\_video.mp4, with no unexpected duplicate copies.
9. File size and duration match the original. The checked sections play without visible or audible corruption.
10. The local original remains available and playable.

TC15\_R01\_video.mp4 was interrupted during an active Wi-Fi upload. The device remained without any network connection for 30 seconds, and Google Drive displayed "Waiting for network."

After Wi-Fi was restored, the upload resumed automatically and completed. No manual retry was performed.

Exactly one copy was visible in the desktop Drive folder. The tester confirmed that the downloaded video matched the original.

Status: Blocked. The manual retry step could not be exercised because the upload recovered automatically. Automatic recovery completed without an observed duplicate file.
